champion: Injectable drug-induced skin and soft tissue injury
ordered_diagnoses: Injectable drug-induced skin and soft tissue injury
gold: Fibrosis and ulceration caused by meperidine
shortlist: Injectable drug-induced skin and soft tissue injury

selector.champion: Injectable drug-induced skin and soft tissue injury
selector.rationale: Patient's history of self-administering subcutaneous injections of meperidine, presence of cutaneous ulcers, and woody induration of skin are consistent with injectable drug-induced injury, and the involvement of both skin and soft tissue makes the more specific diagnosis the champion

rejected.label: Pancreatic panniculitis
rejected.why: No evidence of pancreatic disease or other typical findings of pancreatic panniculitis

rejected.label: Contracture and fibrosis
rejected.why: While contracture and fibrosis are present, they are more likely secondary to the injectable drug use

rejected.label: Scleroderma
rejected.why: Lack of typical scleroderma findings such as vasculitis, thrombosis, or polarizable foreign material, and the presence of a clear history of injectable drug use
